name: MCUxJJK
description: ⚡ Dark cinematic anime & superhero crossover mobile app fusing Marvel Cinematic Universe heroes with Jujutsu Kaisen sorcerers using Gemini AI. Built with Flutter.

paragraphs: Dark cinematic anime & superhero crossover multiverse application powered by Gemini AI. Fuses iconic Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) heroes with Jujutsu Kaisen (JJK) sorcerers, synthesizing custom hybrid characters, domain expansions, cursed techniques, cosmic abilities, and lore.
features: 🧠 Gemini AI Character Synthesis: Real-time generation of custom hybrid characters combining Jujutsu occult techniques with Marvel cosmic physics.
🎨 Dark Anime Occult Aesthetics: Cyberpunk neon glow, deep void black (#050508), glassmorphism, laser accents, and dynamic particle effects designed with Google Stitch.
🖼️ High-Resolution Anime Artworks: Every fusion character includes cinematic anime hybrid artwork bundled directly as local assets.
🛡️ Instant Offline Fallback: If offline or if the API limit is reached, an onboard occult algorithmic engine synthesizes full character dossiers instantly.
📱 Cross-Platform: Responsive Flutter app running seamlessly on Web (GitHub Pages), Android APK, and Desktop.
